note: Source of truth for the Structures page (structures.html) — the maps this site is built on, plus the canonical maps of the psyche. Each structure renders as a stack of labelled bands: form 'strata' = full-width bands; form 'pyramid' = bands that widen towards the base (so write the base LAST). 'layers' are top-to-bottom as they should appear. Editorial prose — refine freely. Literal Unicode only — no HTML entities.

structures.name: The Curriculum
structures.kicker: The whole site, as one map
structures.intro: The Psyche read as a single building — four storeys of the self, raised from the ground up. Each series is one floor; each case a room on it.

layers.label: I · The Foundations
layers.note: What a strong self is built on — worth, agency, fear, discipline, purpose. The character set, not the clinic's.

layers.label: II · The Body
layers.note: The self runs on a physical engine. A shortage or a crash does not announce itself as chemistry — it wears the mask of a mood.

layers.label: III · The Wanting
layers.note: Desire, scarcity, and the counterfeit cures — the bowl that gold cannot fill, and the gratitude that is really a lid.

layers.label: IV · The Future Self
layers.note: The stranger you keep mailing the bill to — the two opposite errors of under- and over-investing in who you will become.

structures.caveat: A living outline: floors are added and reordered as the work grows. Read from the ground up — the higher rooms lean on the lower ones.

structures.name: The Foundations of a Self
structures.intro: Not how the self was formed — that is the clinic's map — but what a strong one is built on, and the order of the work. Series I climbs this ladder from the ground up.

layers.label: Purpose
layers.note: A why you can carry almost any how towards. Without it, no technique holds.

layers.label: Discipline
layers.note: Choosing what you want most over what you want now — and the first place it is physical: the fork, the night, the glass you do not buy. Motivation is a liar; acting anyway is freedom.

layers.label: Fear
layers.note: Almost every flaw is fear in costume — shame, avoidance, the comfort of the known. Love and presence are not summoned; they are what remains when the fear leaves.

layers.label: Agency
layers.note: Author, not victim. You do not choose the weather; you author the response — always. The keystone.

layers.label: Worth
layers.note: Built, not handed out; non-contingent, owned outright. The ground everything else stands on.

structures.caveat: A curriculum, not a diagnosis. The order is load-bearing — nothing above holds until Worth and Agency are under it.

structures.name: The Locus of Control
structures.intro: A map of where you believe the steering wheel is. The Cage keeps three comfortable seats; the open field has none — and it is the only one of the four that is free.

layers.label: The Blamer
layers.note: The airtight case against the world. Every brick a true grievance — and the whole cell built of them. You can be right, or you can be free.

layers.label: The Waiter
layers.note: Abdication dressed as reverence: leaving it to fate or a sign to authorise the choice that was always yours. Not choosing is a choice.

layers.label: The Performer
layers.note: Enormous discipline, no agency. Top billing on a script written by other people — a very well-decorated cell.

layers.label: The Author
layers.note: Radical responsibility. Put down the alibi, pick up the pen, and face the actual weather. Exposed, unguaranteed, and real.

structures.caveat: Fault is about the past; responsibility is about what you do next. You can carry a wound that was not your fault and still be the only one who can tend it.

structures.name: The Two Hungers
structures.intro: The brain keeps two systems, and they are not the same: the one that chases and the one that enjoys. Almost every craving lives in the gap between them.

layers.label: Wanting
layers.note: The 'go get it' pull — loud, forward-leaning, easily hijacked. It can run long after the pleasure is gone.

layers.label: Liking
layers.note: The actual payoff — quieter, smaller, quick to fade, and usually far less than the wanting promised.

layers.label: The Gap
layers.note: Where the trap is built. Engineered things widen it: maximal pull, minimal payoff — the cigarette's hole, the bottomless bowl, the bite made to be craved.

layers.label: The Pause
layers.note: Wanting fades if it is not fed. You do not have to obey a pull to watch it pass — that half-second is the whole of the freedom.

structures.caveat: Naming the pull as wanting, not needing, is most of the work. The two systems feel identical from the inside until you look.

structures.name: The Future Self
structures.kicker: Series IV · one bond, two errors
structures.intro: One relationship with a single measure: how much of the present you owe the person you are becoming — and the cost of getting it wrong in either direction.

layers.label: Underinvestment
layers.note: Filing the person you'll become as a stranger, and mailing them the bill. The debt disguises itself as freedom.

layers.label: The Bridge
layers.note: Treating the future self as real and owed to — paying forward, without enslaving the whole present to a plan.

layers.label: Overinvestment
layers.note: Unable to let go, because you already spent the future on it: it became your identity, and releasing it would demolish a self you already live inside.

structures.caveat: The question is never simply 'more' or 'less'. It is honesty: a bond with a real future self, a bill mailed to a stranger, or a prison you built and moved into?

structures.name: The Body's Ledger
structures.kicker: Series II · the chemistry of agency
structures.intro: The mind does not float free; it runs on a physical engine. This is the hardware that decides whether you have the capacity to author a response at all — or whether chemistry makes the choice for you.

layers.label: The Thieves — Substances
layers.note: Alcohol laundering agency, nicotine digging the hole it pretends to fill. The pen, voluntarily and repeatedly surrendered.

layers.label: The Regulators — Sleep & Light
layers.note: Claiming the morning instead of surviving it; the stance for the whole day is half-won the night before.

layers.label: The Fuel — Blood Sugar
layers.note: The fast crash that dresses up as an existential crisis, and the slow caramelising of tissue that never sends a receipt.

layers.label: The Baseline — Minerals & Elements
layers.note: Magnesium, zinc, calcium — the rock the nervous system stands on. A shortage here does not announce itself; it wears the mask of a mood.

structures.caveat: None of these arrive labelled as chemistry — they arrive disguised as your personality. The first move is to suspect the machine before you indict the self.

structures.name: Freud's Structural Model
structures.intro: The mind read as three forces in constant negotiation, most of it below the waterline of awareness. A century old and much revised — but still the vocabulary everyone borrows.

layers.label: Superego
layers.note: The internalised rules and ideals — conscience, and the image of who you ought to be.

layers.label: Ego
layers.note: The negotiator and reality-tester, brokering between drive, conscience, and the world as it is.

layers.label: Id
layers.note: The reservoir of drive and appetite — wants, now, without limit or logic.

structures.caveat: A historical map, not a brain diagram. Treat it as a useful metaphor for inner conflict, not a literal anatomy.

structures.name: Jung's Model of the Psyche
structures.kicker: From the mask to the Self
structures.intro: Consciousness as a small lit circle inside a vast inherited dark. Individuation is the long work of moving from the outermost mask down towards the Self at the centre.

layers.label: Persona
layers.note: The mask worn for the world — useful, until you mistake it for the whole of you.

layers.label: Ego
layers.note: The centre of consciousness; the 'I' that knows itself.

layers.label: Personal Unconscious
layers.note: Forgotten and repressed material, gathered into charged complexes.

layers.label: The Shadow
layers.note: What the ego disowns — refused, and therefore where much of the power is kept.

layers.label: Anima / Animus
layers.note: The contrasexual inner figure; the bridge from the ego down into the depths.

layers.label: Collective Unconscious
layers.note: Inherited patterns shared across all people — the archetypes.

layers.label: The Self
layers.note: The centre and totality of the whole psyche; what individuation moves towards.

structures.caveat: Read outer-to-inner: this is a depth gradient, not a ranking — the Self is the core, not the top.

structures.name: Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs
structures.intro: A ladder of human needs, each rung said to press hardest once the ones below it are reasonably met — from staying alive at the base to becoming fully yourself at the top.

layers.label: Self-Actualisation
layers.note: Becoming what you are capable of — growth, meaning, the fullest use of the self.

layers.label: Esteem
layers.note: Competence, respect, and standing — both earned and given.

layers.label: Love & Belonging
layers.note: Intimacy, friendship, being part of something.

layers.label: Safety
layers.note: Security of body, resources, and a predictable world.

layers.label: Physiological
layers.note: Air, water, food, warmth, rest — the body kept alive.

structures.caveat: The strict 'lower needs first' ordering is contested — people reach for meaning under hardship all the time. Hold it as a rough map, not a law.
